name: Park Hyatt St. Kitts
insider_take: This ultra-luxury resort sits on the pristine Banana Bay, where Caribbean elegance meets volcanic island mystique on St. Kitts' stunning southeastern peninsula.
whats_special: Built on a former sugar plantation, this Park Hyatt showcases St. Kitts' rich colonial heritage while offering panoramic views of the dormant Mount Liamuiga volcano. The resort features the island's only overwater villas in the Caribbean, and guests can explore nearby UNESCO World Heritage Brimstone Hill Fortress - one of the best-preserved colonial fortifications in the Americas.
pro_tip: Book the sunset sailing excursion to neighboring Nevis - you'll sail through "The Narrows" strait where pirates once hid their treasure, and the golden hour light on both islands is absolutely magical.
dont_miss: The resort's signature rum tasting featuring locally-distilled spirits from the island's historic sugar estates, and snorkeling at the nearby Shitten Bay where sea turtles nest. The hotel's spa treatments using indigenous volcanic sand and sea salt are uniquely St. Kitts experiences you won't find elsewhere.
pros: Luxurious beachfront location with pristine Caribbean waters
Hyatt PRIVE' program benefits and exclusive perks
Elegant suites with private terraces and ocean views
cons: Remote island location requires connecting flights
